result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visible layout and readability issues, mainly caused by horizontal content clipping and the fixed bottom navigation covering content.

issues.description: The horizontally scrolling category row and “Fastest near you” cards are visibly cut off at the right edge of the viewport. The last category appears only partially and the third restaurant card is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the carousel to the viewport and provide clear horizontal scrolling behavior, such as intentional edge fade, spacing, or scroll indicators. Ensure cards do not appear accidentally clipped.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant content. The second popular restaurant card is cut off by the navigation bar, making its image and details difficult to access.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so the final card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The white promotional text on the pale mint banner has weak visual contrast, especially the subtitle, and may be difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text or a darker banner treatment, and verify the text/background contrast meets accessibility guidelines.

issues.description: The right edge of the horizontal sections has abrupt clipping with no visual cue that more content is available off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade or partial-card affordance consistently, or include a visible horizontal scroll cue while preserving the intended carousel behavior.
